sections.label: Women's labour force participation rate
sections.summary: The labour force participation rate for women rose steadily from 68.4% in 2010 to 76.6% in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: The labour force participation rate for women has been rising steadily from 68.4% in 2010 to 76.6% in 2020.

sections.label: Employers offering flexible work arrangements
sections.summary: In 2020, the proportion of employers providing some form of flexible work arrangements rose to 93%, and almost half provided formal tele-working arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: In 2020, the proportion of employers that provided some form of flexible work arrangements rose to 93% and almost half of employers provided formal tele-working arrangements.

sections.label: Working from home preferences and intentions
sections.summary: A July survey showed four in five workers wished to continue working from home at least half the time, and a recent MOM poll showed more than three in five businesses intend to allow this post-COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Particularly, on working from home, a survey conducted in July last year showed that four in five workers wished to continue to work from home for at least half the time, even after Government measures are lifted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: In a recent MOM online poll, more than three in five businesses indicated that they intend to continue to allow employees to work from home at least half the time post-COVID-19.

sections.label: TAFEP discrimination cases handled
sections.summary: TAFEP handled an average of 400 discrimination cases annually over three years, including proactive MOM checks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) handled an average of 400 discrimination cases annually, including those arising from proactive checks by MOM.

sections.label: Penal Code abuse safeguards
sections.summary: The Penal Code was enhanced in 2020 to double maximum punishment for abusing vulnerable people, including foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: The Penal Code was enhanced in 2020 to double the maximum punishment against individuals who abuse vulnerable people, including foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: MOM has been reviewing measures to better support foreign domestic workers and strengthen safeguards against abuse in three areas.

sections.label: Interviews and doctor reporting
sections.summary: One-on-one interviews and mandatory off days would give abused foreign domestic workers more chances to seek help.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: One-on-one interviews after newly arrived foreign domestic workers start work with employers and mandatory off days would also give abused foreign domestic workers more opportunities to seek help.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Second, in terms of the reporting by doctors, we will work with the medical fraternity to better identify signs of abuse or distress.

sections.label: Care-givers Support Action Plan
sections.summary: The Government strengthened support for care-givers via the Care-givers Support Action Plan announced in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Government has strengthened areas of support for care-givers via the Care-givers Support Action Plan that was announced in 2019.

sections.label: Home-caring grant payouts
sections.summary: MOH introduced a home-caring grant in October 2019 providing $200 monthly to eligible individuals with permanent moderate disability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOH has introduced a home-caring grant in October 2019 to help defray the costs of care-giving in the community.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: This grant provides a $200 payout per month to eligible individuals with permanent moderate disability that can be used to offset the cost of home and community care services – transport expenses to travel for medical appointments and cost of hiring a foreign domestic worker.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Households that need financial assistance for their basic living expenses including the low-wage stay home care-givers can also approach Social Services Office which will look into ways to support them.

sections.label: Financial services roles identified
sections.summary: In financial services, 121 roles were identified.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the case of financial services, for example, we identified 121 roles.

sections.label: Job roles and sectors studied
sections.summary: The study identified 56 existing logistics roles, 12 new roles, and 12 other completed sectors including wholesale trade, retail and tourism.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the case of logistics, it is 56 existing job roles and the specific technology we are looking at is Internet of Things, on the AR/VR or augmented reality, virtual reality, and blockchain.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the process of doing this study, over and above the 56 roles that were identified, another 12 new roles that the industry will need were also identified.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: To Mr Choo's specific question, which are the other 12 sectors apart from human resources, financial services and logistics that were completed, they are the wholesale trade, retail, food manufacturing, infocomm and media, supply chain management, accountancy, in-house finance and accounting functions, construction, facilities management, land transport, environmental services and tourism.

sections.label: Programme take-up extension
sections.summary: The programme was extended because more take-up was wanted.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As to whether we would like more take-up of the programme, that is the reason why we extended it.

sections.label: SGUnited Traineeships employment expectation
sections.summary: Trainees were not expected to gain employment with the same company or industry.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, to Mr Yip's first question on the SGUnited Traineeships Programme, even at the start, we did not expect that the trainees must gain employment with the same company or within the same industry.

sections.label: Traineeships not completed
sections.summary: Most trainees have not completed their traineeships.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In any case, most of the trainees have not completed their traineeships.

sections.label: Tripartite work group on lower wage workers
sections.summary: A tripartite work group is intensively engaged in moving on lower wage workers.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: At this point in time, we have a tripartite work group that is very intensively engaged in moving on lower wage workers.

sections.label: Foreign domestic workers in NGO activities
sections.summary: In 2019, about 158,000 foreign domestic workers participated in courses, services and activities organised by NGOs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In 2019, about 158,000 foreign domestic workers participated in courses, services and activities organised by various NGOs.

sections.label: FAST new clubhouse
sections.summary: FAST is building a new clubhouse 10 times larger than its current premises, with capacity for 5,000 people, opening in the second half of the year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: FAST is building a new clubhouse that will be 10 times larger than their current premises, with a capacity of 5,000 people and I am looking forward to opening it in the second half of the year.

sections.label: LRIS product design
sections.summary: LRIS aims to be a low-cost, passively run investment product for CPF members using their long time horizon, and takes time to design.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As to LRIS, what we were really trying to do is to create a product that will not be costly for CPF members to invest through, to basically make it something that is passively run and also takes advantage of the long time horizon that you have for your CPF savings.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As I have explained in my speech, this is obviously not going to be an easy product to design.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: I can only say that, there is a Chinese expression, "慢工出细货", that is, if you want a very fine product, it does take a bit of time.

sections.label: Tripartite advisory adoption tracking
sections.summary: MOM is working with employers and HR groups to promote the tripartite advisory, and will track adoption through MOM surveys every two years, starting later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Besides NTUC, MOM is also working with employers and HR groups to promote the adoption of the tripartite advisory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And as suggested by Mr Yong, we will track the adoption of the MOM surveys every two years, with the first occurring later this year.

sections.label: Enhanced mandatory safety training
sections.summary: From 2022, mandatory construction safety training will include experiential elements simulating high-risk situations, and cleaners will undergo mandatory WSH courses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Also, to the Member's earlier point about safety training, we have also enhanced our mandatory safety courses for workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, from 2022, mandatory construction safety training will need to include experiential elements that simulate high-risk situations, such as falls from heights, collapsing scaffolding and crushed by machinery, so that workers, especially in construction, can better understand the workplace safety and health risks at the construction sites.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: From 2022, cleaners will also undergo mandatory WSH courses which provide cleaners with skills to carry out their work safely.

sections.label: Singaporean workers employment regime
sections.summary: The Member asks the Minister to confirm whether Singaporean workers are disadvantaged by foreign workers not contributing to CPF, no EP quota, and no skills transfer or succession planning requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: First, I would like the Minister to confirm whether the Singaporean workers have been disadvantaged under the current employment regime whereby a wage disadvantage is against Singaporeans because foreign workers do not contribute to CPF, there is no quota on EP holders, there is no skills transfer requirement, there is no succession planning requirement.

sections.label: Workfare introduced in 2007
sections.summary: Workfare was introduced in 2007 at no cost to employers, so there is no dis-employment risk to the worker.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Actually, we took that big step in 2007 through the introduction of Workfare and this comes at no cost to the employers and, therefore, no dis-employment risk to the worker.

sections.label: Foreign workforce employment contraction
sections.summary: Mr Liang Eng Hwa pointed out the foreign workforce contracted by over one hundred and eighty thousand in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: To his question on whether we have disadvantaged Singaporeans, I am not sure whether Mr Leong was in here when Mr Liang Eng Hwa delivered his cut which, I thought, was so sharp in pointing out that when you look at 2020, the tremendous trauma that our employment market went through over the course of the whole year, what was the employment contraction?

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Foreign workforce – one hundred and eighty-plus thousand.

sections.label: SMEs pandemic recovery survey
sections.summary: About two-thirds of respondents were negatively impacted, 85% are SMEs, and 70% expect recovery to take over a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Janet Ang (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Among those negatively impacted, which comprise about two-thirds of the respondents and the majority are SMEs – 85% of the respondents are SMEs – 70% think that they will take more than a year to recover from the pandemic.
